resources.string: “Allow only these” profiles are part of NowFocus Pro.
Running an “Allow only these” profile is part of NowFocus Pro. This one is kept, and starts once this account is on Pro.
Cheat day is part of NowFocus Pro. A day you planned earlier is kept, and applies again once this account is on Pro.
Bedtime Wind-Down is part of NowFocus Pro. Your settings are kept, but nothing starts and the screen isn\'t locked until this account is on Pro.
Sync is part of NowFocus Pro, and this account is on the free plan.
